purpose: Freeze the independent Browser/UI QA Gate after the RH4 Hosted Gate, exact deployed-source freshness, representative real-browser interaction validation, candidate Project Check success, and integrated-main Browser/UI success. Keep semantic, ConfigData, frontend implementation, asset authority, deployment writer, Hosted contract, and Status Source authority outside this Browser/UI checkpoint.

reviews.detail: An earlier Browser/UI candidate run failed in scripts/validate-soldier-detail-hero-cards-hosted.mjs because that legacy validator can observe the '사용 가능 영웅' heading before asynchronous Hero-card data is ready and then immediately count zero images. The same deployed source had passed that legacy validator in authoritative hosted verification. The independent Browser/UI Gate does not modify the legacy validator; it validates the same presentation meaning with an explicit attached-and-loaded WebP ready-state condition.

This freeze records representative Browser/UI coverage required for the current hosted surfaces and interactions. It does not claim that every possible filter combination, storage path, device, pixel-level layout state, or future UI control has been exhaustively enumerated. New or changed interaction contracts require targeted Browser/UI extension without reopening completed semantic stages.

nonScope: No semantic, canonical, relation, ConfigData, localization, frontend implementation, or asset data is changed by this Browser/UI freeze.
No GitHub Pages writer, gh-pages mutation, force-push, repository writer, Status Source writer, or Project Status writer is introduced by the Browser/UI workflow.
No Browser/UI failure is promoted into a semantic, relation, ConfigData, or Hosted failure without owning-layer evidence.
No legacy Browser validator is silently made authoritative for semantic meaning; reused validators remain presentation/runtime evidence only.
nextStart: Validate this Browser/UI freeze checkpoint on its pull request with required project-check and the independent Browser/UI workflow against the exact deployed base source. If both PASS, merge the freeze. Then require authoritative Pages deployment, Route Hosted strict validation, and Browser/UI exact-source validation on the freeze merge SHA. Classify Browser/UI as COMPLETE only after that freeze revalidation succeeds.
reopenConditions: The RH4 Hosted Gate predecessor no longer satisfies its frozen completion requirements.
The Browser/UI workflow no longer validates the exact deployed source SHA or no longer runs only after successful Hosted Gate validation on main.
Authoritative Browser/UI interaction contracts change for navigation, keyboard/touch behavior, responsive layout, direct entry, error handling, or representative detail surfaces.
A current-branch-only Browser/UI or Project Check failure is causally owned by the Browser/UI workflow, checkpoint ownership rule, or current Browser/UI interaction contract.
Authoritative evidence shows Browser/UI validation mutates repository/deployment state or improperly assumes semantic, ConfigData, frontend, or asset authority.
